title: Read a file, handle the unexpected
A small debounce helper
Split a collection into chunks
Find recently updated snippets
content:
SELECT title, language, updated_at
FROM snippets
WHERE updated_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days'
ORDER BY updated_at DESC
LIMIT 20;

title: See what is listening on a port
content:
# Find the process listening on the development port.
lsof -nP -iTCP:1420 -sTCP:LISTEN

title: A place for the useful little things
content:
# Your local snippet library

This prototype keeps snippets on this computer.

- Search titles, filenames, tags, and code.
- Edit a snippet and save it to disk.
- Close and reopen the app to keep working.

GitHub sync and rich previews are future milestones.
